_comment: WHAT THIS FILE NO LONGER CLAIMS.
It used to carry figures presented as the ERE/2026-06-30 production truth:
Those numbers were never observed in production. They came from in-process
runs against the locally reachable demonstration dataset and were keyed to
the live portfolio id without ever being checked against it. The first live
run of this gate reported 958 loans and GBP 159,097,304.07, and the fixture
duly failed the deployed service for not matching a book it does not hold.
A certification that asserts figures nobody verified against the thing being
certified is not evidence; it is a fixture wearing evidence's clothes. So the
numeric constants are gone rather than corrected.
THEY WERE NOT REPLACED WITH THE LIVE FIGURES. Reading 958 loans back out of
the API and storing it as the truth the API must match would let the service
certify itself: any drift becomes the new expectation, and the check can only
ever pass. The gate is scored on IDENTITIES instead - relations between the
answers in one run, which hold on any book on any date and cannot be
satisfied by a service simply repeating itself:
* the regional cells sum to the total the same run reports;
* the filtered Scottish answer reconciles to the Scottish membership of
the grouped labels, as the GOVERNED region owner resolves it - the
harness asks mi_agent.region_resolution rather than mapping regions
itself, because a mapping here would be a second taxonomy;
* the explicit property-region answer agrees with the generic region
answer, because the asset configures collateral as the primary basis;
* a narrowing never grows the population it narrows;
* a question naming an unresolved qualifier refuses.
WHAT REMAINS BELOW is configuration, not measurement: which asset class this
client declares and which basis its asset pack configures. Both are verified
against the deployed service's own response rather than against a stored
figure, and neither can drift silently because the release that changes them
changes this file too.
IF A FROZEN NUMERIC FIXTURE IS EVER WANTED AGAIN it must carry, alongside the
portfolio and run id, an immutable identity for the dataset it was computed
from (a fingerprint the service also publishes), and a record of how the
figures were produced independently of the parser, the query planner, the MI
executor and this scorer. A run against a different dataset identity must
then report STALE_FIXTURE rather than a numerical failure - because that is
what it would be.
